answer: Island paired-receipt bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity stakes a 70-credit bond, claims an island karst plot, and files a receipt: a 14-line signed record, one line per marker. It swaps receipts with a neighbor; both enter the atlas ledger. An auditor replays sampled pairs each epoch; a mismatch or reuse burns both bonds. First 36, k-th 36+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 2,533,500 plus 70,000 bonded for 40,000 rewards. Honest agents pay 36 once.
